lectern.title: Mods
lectern.config.show_libraries.tip: Include the loader and library mods in the list by default.
lectern.config.compact_rows.tip: Draw rows tighter, fitting more mods on screen.
lectern.config.remember_search.tip: Keep what you typed when the screen is reopened.
lectern.config.take_over.tip: Take over the loader's Mods button. Turn off to leave it alone and get a separate Lectern button instead. Takes effect on restart.
